label: Bible Study
prompt: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In _____ and offerings.
verse: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.
note: Malachi's pointed question — the people asked 'how?' and got a four-word answer.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and _____.
verse: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
note: Joshua and Caleb's plea: if the LORD delights in us, He'll bring us into a land of milk and honey.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the _____ lay.
verse: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
note: Friends dug through a roof to lower the man down — 'sick of the palsy' is the KJV's way of saying paralysed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: On that night could not the king _____, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.
verse: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.
note: One sleepless night, one boring chronicle, and Mordecai's forgotten good deed comes to light — God is unnamed but busy.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not _____ their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
verse: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
note: God was in Christ reconciling the world, 'not imputing' — not charging — their trespasses unto them.
